game.title: Fortune favors the fearless.
game.subtitle: Spin your heroes. Unleash their power. Bring down Roshan.
game.logEmpty: The pit is quiet. Make your first move.
game.restartBody: Your current battle will be replaced. Earned progress stays with you.
game.free: No stakes. Just strategy, luck, and a very angry Roshan.
game.freeArcade: Free to play. No stakes, payments, or cash prizes.
game.loadingHint: Restoring your progress and preparing the arena.
game.loadingError: Some game assets could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.

guide.title: Know your arsenal
guide.subtitle: Five reels. Six heroes. Seven artifacts.
guide.rules: Match 3, 4, or 5 identical symbols from the left on any marked line. Four doubles the power. Five unleashes an ultimate. Each spin costs one charge. Roshan attacks every third spin.
guide.weights: Heroes weight 12 · Artifacts weight 3. Each spin selects a weighted rally symbol: every cell has a 44% rally chance, otherwise it uses the full weighted pool. No guaranteed matches.
guide.itemsRule: Artifacts activate with 3+ matches on a line.

item.refresher-orb: Repeats the last effect 1 / 2 / 3 times (damage, healing, shields, and spins).
item.healing-salve: Restores 20 / 40 / 60 HP before Roshan attacks, up to 100 HP.

result.wonBody: Your heroes stood together. The spoils are yours.
result.lostBody: Every run builds your legacy. Return stronger.
result.saved: Rewards added to your profile. Your victory is part of your legacy.

settings.title: Settings
settings.soundHint: Original Dota 2 effects: Roshan, sword impacts, and healing.
settings.resetBody: Your level, rewards, statistics, and current run will be permanently cleared on this browser.

footer.note: A fan-made, offline-first adventure. Not affiliated with Valve.

site.title: A different world in every spin.
site.subtitle: Choose your challenge. Build your legacy. Start with the Roshan pit.

home.subtitle: Choose a world and jump into the action. Your progress stays with you, right in this browser.
home.description: Summon legendary heroes, discover powerful artifacts, and take on Roshan. Every formation unleashes a new attack.
home.localBody: Play a short run or return to your saved battle whenever you want.
home.fairBody: No payments, no bets, no cash prizes. Your rewards are part of the adventure.
home.worldsBody: Each game has its own atmosphere and rules, inside one familiar interface.

preview.league: A new arena of champions and legendary combinations.
preview.counter: Tactical precision. A new spin on the competitive arena.
preview.valorant: Agents, abilities, and a new challenge in every round.
preview.warcraft: Azeroth, legendary loot, and epic adventures.

arcadeGuide.title: How to play Spin Arcade
arcadeGuide.intro: Choose a game from the catalog. Each world has its own rules and abilities.
arcadeGuide.chooseBody: Open an available game card. Cards marked “Coming soon” are in development.
arcadeGuide.rulesBody: On a game page, “How to play” opens the rules for that specific game, including from your account menu.
arcadeGuide.progressBody: Your profile and progress are saved in this browser. Use the same browser to continue.

gauntlet.title: Roshan Gauntlet
gauntlet.classicDescription: Defeat Roshan in a single battle.
gauntlet.description: Face stronger Roshan stages, collect upgrades and runes, and beat your personal best.
gauntlet.noUpgrades: Win a stage to start building your arsenal.
gauntlet.rewardApplied: Reward saved. Your next challenge awaits.
gauntlet.savedHint: Choose exactly one reward. Health carries over; unused spins do not. Your choice is saved immediately.
gauntlet.restartBody: Your current Arcade Run and its upgrades will be replaced. Your personal best and Classic progress stay saved.
gauntlet.rules: After every victory, choose one of three rewards. HP carries between stages. Every fifth Roshan is empowered; curses begin at stage 3. Each stage has a 100-spin safety limit, including bonus spins.
gauntlet.runeHint: One rune activates automatically next stage. Hero damage affects all combinations; Arcane Knowledge affects 4–5 hero matches. Inspect Current Build for exact bonuses.

defeat.hp: Roshan has defeated you. Try a different build.
defeat.spins: No spins left. Your next run could go further.

vitality.name: Vitality
vitality.description: Maximum HP +{value}. Each level also heals 20 HP.

battle-recovery.name: Battle Recovery
battle-recovery.description: Heal {value} HP after each future victory.

artifact-mastery.name: Artifact Mastery
artifact-mastery.description: Numeric artifact effects +{value}%. Refresher repeats are unchanged.

second-wind.name: Second Wind
second-wind.description: Once per stage, survive lethal damage with {value} HP.

double-damage.name: Double Damage Rune
double-damage.description: Next stage: ×{multiplier} final damage for {duration} spins.

regeneration.name: Regeneration Rune
regeneration.description: Heal {healing} HP when the next stage starts.

haste.name: Haste Rune
haste.description: Next stage starts with {spins} additional spins.

arcane.name: Arcane Rune
arcane.description: Next stage: hero damage +{bonus}% for {duration} spins.

invisibility.name: Invisibility Rune
invisibility.description: Next stage: heal {healing} HP and block the first {duration} Roshan attacks.

shield.name: Shield Rune
shield.description: Start the next stage with {shields} extra blocks.

illusion.name: Illusion Rune
illusion.description: Next stage: current hero combinations echo {bonus}% damage for {duration} spins. Items and Refresher copies are excluded.

exhaustion.name: Exhaustion
exhaustion.description: One fewer base spin this stage.

brutal-strikes.name: Brutal Strikes
brutal-strikes.description: Roshan attacks every 2 spins instead of 3.

progression.scopeHint: Hero damage affects every hero combination. Ability damage affects 4–5 hero matches. Critical damage affects Phantom Assassin and the Daedalus critical bonus. Charges round up; damage rounds once after modifiers.
progression.noRecords: Finish a run to start your records.
progression.recordsHint: Average stage counts completed, recorded runs. Restarts count toward total runs, not completed results. Duration includes time between spins and reloads.
progression.legacyRecords: Earlier totals and best stage were preserved. Historical average and duration are available for runs recorded since this update.
progression.victorySummary: Blocked: {blocked} · Healing: +{healing} HP · Bonus spins: +{spins} · Victory recovery: +{recovery} HP
progression.permanent: For the rest of this run

events.ready: Keep your build ready for the next strike.

buildImpact.title: See your build at work
buildImpact.levelHint: Upgrade level is separate from stage. One reward gives one level: at least {max} victories for one maximum upgrade, {capacity} for all ten, before rune choices. This is a technical cap, not a typical run milestone.
buildImpact.preview: Same combination, with and without your build
buildImpact.previewHint: Hero examples use this Roshan, your build and active rune, without items. Item examples use your permanent build. Damage is not capped by remaining boss HP. These are comparisons, not predictions.
buildImpact.trackedHint: Damage sources add up to HP actually removed. Older damage before tracking started is excluded. This is an attribution breakdown, not a replay of a run without upgrades.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Choose a site theme. Each game keeps its own visual world.

uiKit.title: UI Kit
uiKit.description: One component library for every page and dialog. Inspect real controls, states, typography and themes.
uiKit.controlHint: Buttons, inputs, selects and toggles use the same 44 px control height. Variants change emphasis, not geometry.
uiKit.heading: Heading · size {size}
uiKit.panelHint: Shared padding, border and radius. Only the surface variant changes.
uiKit.dialogHint: A shared modal shell manages appearance, focus, Escape, scrolling and the game fullscreen portal.
uiKit.colorHint: Tokens describe a purpose. Light and dark palettes share the same names; components never select a palette themselves.
